tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search pages already published on https://www.al-taswia.com. Read-only. Send a topic, not client names, contact details, or case files. Personal-status topics are refused. Each answer cites a law name, an article number, and a page URL.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Return one published https://www.al-taswia.com page that states a law name and an article number. Read-only. Do not send client data. Personal-status topics are refused.

tools.name: list_official_sources
tools.description: List official legislation links already cited on published https://www.al-taswia.com pages. Read-only. Send a topic, not client data. Personal-status topics are refused.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_articles · Private data: search_articles · Public sink: search_articles, get_article, list_official_sources.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_articles · Private data: search_articles · Public sink: search_articles, get_article, list_official_sources

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
